name: page-head
description: The 60px bar under the nav bar of a work page: the page's title and its main action on the left, secondary actions on the right, one hairline underneath.

props.name: title
props.description: Page title (an h1), cut with an ellipsis when it is too long.

props.name: main_action
props.description: Label of the text button next to the title.

props.name: editable
props.description: The title can be clicked to rename it: shows the text cursor and a dotted underline on hover and keyboard focus. The host swaps in the input on click; the component only styles the two states.

props.name: editing
props.description: Render the rename field (.ds-page-head__title-input) in place of the title. Same type tokens, no padding or border, so the bar does not change size.

props.name: actions_left
props.description: List of {label, href?, submit?, underline?} rendered as text buttons next to the title, replacing main_action. An empty list renders none. Unset: the single main_action button, as before.

props.name: actions_right
props.description: Same item shape, rendered on the right, replacing the fixed Undo / Download PDF buttons. An empty list renders none. Unset: those two buttons, as before.

props.name: meta_text
props.description: A passive line of text after the left-hand actions (counts, a note). Plain text, not interactive.

rationale: Height is spacing.9 + spacing.6 (60px), side padding spacing.6 (20px), bg.surface with one hairline (object-dark.passive) under it. The title is the heading-3 role (Inter 24px; one step above the heading-4 the Figma frames use, 2026-10-18, explicit request: the set name read too small) with line-height normal, so the bar's height, not the type scale, sets the rhythm. The gap between title and main action is spacing.cell (10px); the right group has no gap because text buttons hug their labels (see text-button). Both groups are flex rows with min-width 0, so a long title ellipsizes instead of pushing the actions out. Rendering verified in light and dark themes. Rename in place (2026-10-11): the title is the heading-4 role; the rename field reuses the same four type tokens with zero padding, border and fill, so swapping title for field changes nothing about the box: no jump, no reflow of the actions. It is marked by an accent line drawn as an inset shadow (not a border, which would add height) and sized to its text with field-sizing: content, capped at the bar. The editable title carries the system's dotted-underline clickable affordance on hover and focus only, so a read-only title looks as before. Not from Figma (the Figma bar draws no editing state); built from existing tokens only. 2026-10-23: min-height instead of height and flex-wrap, so on a narrow window the groups wrap onto a second row instead of widening the page; at full width it is still 60px.
a11y_notes: The title is an h1. The buttons are real text-buttons; keyboard focus uses their own ring. An editable title is focusable (tabindex 0) and the host opens the field on Enter or F2 as well as click; the field has aria-label 'Set name'. Escape cancels and Enter or leaving the field commits, both owned by the host.
